title: London’s Plague Pits
sentences: When the plague reached London in 1348, the churchyards filled up fast.
So the city opened new burial grounds.
At East Smithfield, the dead were laid in long trenches.
Archaeologists excavated it in the 1980s and found hundreds of skeletons.
Their DNA later helped prove what caused the Black Death.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
caption:
London dug long trenches for the dead.
